messages:
sophia: Heads-up: ACME reported their account went negative after a refunded invoice was later reversed. They say trial credits disappeared and now API calls are failing with 402/insufficient_funds and some 401s. Ticket #7892 attached.
liam-billing: Thanks — pulling the refund reversal logs now. Did we trigger any automatic credit clawback on reversal?
kevin-oncall: @liam-billing I saw a similar pattern last month where chargeback webhook came in after the trial-credit allocation TTL expired and the credit ledger adjustment ran twice. Can you paste the webhook payload and invoice id?
maya-cs: Customer says they got an email: "Refund reversed due to disputed charge" then their dashboard showed -$23.40 and endpoints started returning 402. Very upset, wants a rollback of the clawback if possible.
sophia: Webhook payload (redacted):
```
{
  "event": "refund.reversed",
  "invoice_id": "inv_0A1B2C3",
  "user": "acme-retail",
  "amount": 2340,
  "currency": "usd"
}
```
liam-billing: Ledger shows: trial_credit_grant id tc_34 applied +5000 at 2026-02-15, then invoice charge -2340 at 2026-03-01, refund +2340 at 2026-03-05, refund.reversal -2340 at 2026-03-12. Clawback job ran at 2026-03-12 03:02 UTC and debited trial credits as a negative adjustment. That left balance negative after also applying pro-rated usage.
raj-eng: If the clawback job double-applied adjustments on reversal we need the exact job run id. @billing-bot can you show the job run metadata for 2026-03-12 03:00-03:10 UTC?
billing-bot: job_run_id: jr_20260312_0302, status: completed, steps: [validate_webhook, map_invoice_to_account, apply_ledger_adjustment, notify_user]. No error logged.
kevin-oncall: Hm — the job logs say completed but we need the raw DB transaction. @liam-billing can you check if apply_ledger_adjustment executed twice for the same webhook idempotency key?
liam-billing: Querying ledger events: found two ledger_event rows with same idempotency_key "refund.reversal:inv_0A1B2C3" created 03:02:12 and 03:02:13. Second had -2340. That explains negative balance. Looks like a race on idempotency lock.
maya-cs: Customer wants immediate remediation — can we credit them so they can use the API and then follow up with legal/collections?
kevin-oncall: Short-term fix: create a manual ledger reversal to add +2340 back to trial credit bucket and temporarily lift billing block. Long-term: fix idempotency check in the clawback worker to use DB-level unique constraint or distributed lock.
liam-billing: I'll issue manual reversal and disable the clawback job for that account until we patch. Doing manual reversal now.
billing-bot: manual_reversal_id: mr_20260312_01 created by liam-billing at 2026-03-12T03:45:02Z, amount +2340, bucket: trial_credits. Account balance now 0.
sophia: Confirmed with customer: dashboard shows $0 and API calls succeeding. They want a full explanation and apology.
kevin-oncall: I'll open an engineering ticket to add a DB unique constraint on idempotency_key + job_name and add a compensating migration to dedupe any future dup events.
raj-eng: Also adding integration test to simulate concurrent webhook delivery.
maya-cs: I'll send the customer a note and include timeline and next steps. Thanks everyone. :heart:
liam-billing: Postmortem and follow-up doc in #postmortems once we finish RCA.
sophia: Cool — closing this Slack thread once postmortem link posted.
